flavor: In the center of the courtyard, a bloated, undead 僵尸 stands atop a stone pedestal, frantically loading massive, magically-infused 卷心菜 into a heavy catapult. Every time the mechanism clicks, a high-pitched whistle echoes through the air, signaling a heavy 攻击 is imminent.
name: The Gardener's Artillery
reason: The party must decide whether to focus fire on the siege-engine zombie to stop the projectiles or ignore it to clear the smaller threats, risking heavy area damage.
